newsitem.title: LEBANON: Lebanon seeks $5 billion at donor conference.
newsitem.headline: Lebanon seeks $5 billion at donor conference.

text.p: Prime Minister Rafik al-Hariri left Beirut Friday for a "Friends of Lebanon" donors conference in Washington, seeking $5 billion over the next five years to help him carry on rebuilding the country.

About 30 countries are expected at the meeting, which the United States agreed to sponsor last April after a 17-day Israeli blitz on Lebanon that hurt its economy and set back its reconstruction drive.
Hariri will propose at the Dec. 16 conference 31 infrastructure projects that his cash-strapped government considers high priority but cannot afford to undertake.
They range from road-building and water projects to education and the environment.
